overview_description.description:
From MIT's App Inventor and YCombinator's W2016 batch, Thunkable allows anyone to build powerful native apps. With Thunkable, it's simple to design, and simple to code-- simply drag and drop to create fast, native, reliable apps. 

You don't need to download large development suites, command-line kits, or simulators. You can use the many built-in app templates as they are, or make changes. Make your changes online and see them on your device instantly with the Thunkable mobile app. Upload your apps directly to the Play Store or send them to friends!

product.name: Thunkable
product.description: A no-code, drag-and-drop platform for designing, building, testing, and publishing native mobile applications for iOS and Android, with support for mobile web deployment.

product.name: Thunkable AI
product.description: An AI-assisted app creation experience that generates app screens, layouts, logic, data connections, integrations, and copy from natural-language prompts, with options for visual and code-based editing.

product.name: Thunkable for Education
product.description: A classroom-oriented app development platform that lets teachers and students create mobile apps with visual programming while learning concepts such as variables, loops, conditionals, and computational thinking.

product.name: Thunkable Company Plan
product.description: A team and organization offering that provides Thunkable licenses and tailored solutions for businesses seeking to use the platform across multiple users or explore custom requirements.
